title: Demo bootstrap seed script
description: Objective: script the human bootstrap so a code node appears on the wrapper's surface without hand-driving the live board or curl. Measured at HEAD 1aa7cdc: nodes appear only after the plan's approval.decide is durably committed (docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:129-131); today that approval is dispatched by hand through the control room live board or hand-built curl to /command. The command payload shapes already exist in apps/control-room/src/live/live-dispatch.ts (payloadFor) and the daemon accepts them on POST /command with the operator credential (x-moe-csrf + session credential headers, http-listener-guards.ts:126-129). Deliverable: one script (new file, e.g. scripts/demo-seed.ts) that, given the daemon origin + operator credential, dispatches the J1 bootstrap chain (project.register/bind_repository/activate as needed, goal.create, plan.propose approval via approval.decide) for one demo node spec in MOE_NODE_SPECS_DIR, waits for each command's durable commit (poll /events/read), and exits 0 with the created ids printed. Every refusal from the daemon is surfaced verbatim with its code/layer. NOT in scope: changing any daemon command or payload contract; inventing new commands; UI changes. Verification: pnpm typecheck; integration smoke against a scratch daemon started via the launcher (or daemon-main directly): seed exits 0, then /affordances/read shows a READY step for the demo node.
definitionOfDone: Running the seed against a fresh scratch daemon produces a READY step on /affordances/read for the demo node, asserted by the smoke, with all dispatched command ids printed.

Every dispatched command's durable commit is confirmed via /events/read before the next is sent; a daemon refusal aborts with the daemon's own code and layer echoed verbatim, covered by a test with a forced refusal.
The script uses only the existing /command + /events/read + /affordances/read surface with documented headers; no daemon source is modified.
pnpm typecheck exits 0; seed tests pass with a nonzero Test Files count line; only explicit owned paths committed.
taskRails: No daemon changes; the seed is a pure client of the existing 6-route HTTP surface.
Do not embed credentials in the script or repo; read them from env with named refusals.
TDD; the forced-refusal test pins the echoed reason code.
